def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    add_on_rate = 6.50
    days_to_maturity = 150
    days_in_year = 360
    bond_year = 365

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    holding_period_return = (add_on_rate / 100) * (days_to_maturity / days_in_year)
    bond_equivalent_yield = holding_period_return * (bond_year / days_to_maturity) * 100

    # return answer
    return round(bond_equivalent_yield, 2)
